headline: Sensex and Nifty end lower after volatile session; Reliance and HDFC Bank in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surge in crude oil prices weighed on investor sentiment
Sharp sell-off from day highs after an initial 500-point rally
Selling pressure in private banking and IT sectors during the afternoon session
Global concerns over a severe AI-detected security bug affecting global websites
whatHappening: Sensex declined 143.21 points to settle at 73,709.69 after a volatile Wednesday session
Nifty 50 slipped to 22,811.35, giving up early gains driven by IT stocks
Reliance Industries discussed energy and technology partnerships with US Senator Rubio at Jamnagar
HDFC Bank initiated an internal probe into an alleged data leak involving senior executives
summary: The Indian stock market ended lower on Wednesday as early gains from IT stocks were erased by a sharp afternoon sell-off. The Sensex fell over 140 points amid rising crude oil prices and volatility in the private banking sector. Key corporate developments include Reliance Industries' new partnership talks and an internal data probe at HDFC Bank.
